fields.label: Statement
fields.text: Re-derive P04's N=1 SDP and P01's SDP with residual accounting. Document the discrepancies found in CORRECTIONS.md (p_m 6.76% vs 6.02%; N 4.2e6 vs 4.48e6; Choi normalisation). This is L1 reproduction value, not a new theorem.
